name: cryptobolt
description: CryptoBolt frontend build tooling and tests: Tailwind CSS compilation, JS module bundling, Content-Security-Policy generation, and a Node test suite for the pure-math technical indicators. The site itself is static HTML/JS with no framework — these scripts compile Tailwind's utility classes to a static stylesheet, concatenate the ordered js/*.js modules into per-page bundles under js/dist/ (see scripts/build-js.js), maintain each page's CSP <meta> tag (see scripts/build-csp.js), and test the shipped indicator math directly (see test/).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:csp
